Button.description:
import { Button } from '@acme/ui'

Triggers an action. Use for the actions on a page or in a form.
Do NOT use for navigation: use a link.

Figma: "Button" component set (variant × size × disabled; label, loading, leadingIcon).
Tokens: color.surface.interactive, color.text.on-interactive, color.border.strong,
radius.control, border-width.default, space.*, font.label-*.

Props
• variant?: primary | secondary | ghost (default primary)
    Visual emphasis.
    - primary: the single most important action in a view. Max one per view.
    - secondary: other actions, e.g. Cancel.
    - ghost: low-emphasis actions inside tables, cards and toolbars.
• size?: sm | md | lg (default md)
    Control size. md is the default; sm for dense tables and toolbars; lg for hero actions.
• disabled?: true | false (default false)
    Prevents interaction and shows the disabled style. Prefer explaining why nearby.
• loading?: true | false (default false)
    Shows a spinner and blocks clicks while an async action runs. Keep a label such as "Saving".
• leadingIcon?
    Optional icon shown before the label.
• children → "label"
    The label. Say what happens ("Save changes"), not "OK".

import { Card } from '@acme/ui'

Page.description:
import { Page } from '@acme/ui'

Outer page container: centres content to a readable width and applies page padding
(space.2xl). Every screen starts with one Page.
Figma: "Page" component with a content slot (= children). Max width 960, space.2xl padding.
In Figma, lay out the content with auto layout frames, gap bound to space/compact|default|section
(vertical = Stack, horizontal + wrap + centred = Cluster). Figma has no Stack or Cluster component.
Added after the first agent build reported it as a gap in the system.

Props
• children → "content"
    Page content. Usually a Stack with gap="section".

Badge.description:
import { Badge } from '@acme/ui'

A short, non-interactive status label, e.g. "Overdue" or "Received".
Do NOT use as a button or link, and never without a text label.

Adapted from shadcn/ui's Badge (MIT): same structure and icon slot,
restyled with Acme tokens. shadcn's secondary, outline, ghost and link
variants and the render-as-link option are intentionally not included.

Figma: "Badge" component set (tone; label, leadingIcon).
Tokens: color.surface.*-subtle, color.surface.subtle, color.text.*,
radius.pill, space.2xs, space.sm, space.xs, font.label-small.

Props
• tone?: neutral | info | success | warning | critical (default neutral)
    Meaning of the status. One tone per meaning, used consistently:
    - neutral: everything else, including pending statuses (draft, request sent).
    - info: informational messages. Not next to actions: it reads as clickable. Use neutral for pending statuses.
    - success: done or verified (supplier replied, measured data).
    - warning: needs attention soon (due soon, estimated data).
    - critical: overdue, failed or blocked.
• leadingIcon?
    Optional icon shown before the label. Sized to the text (12px). Decorative only.
• children → "label"
    The label. Always required: colour is never the only signal. Sentence case, two or three words
    that make sense read on their own ("Estimated data", not "Estimated").
